outgoing_fields.first_round: exact complete prepared/first-request.json body, including versioned dynamic instructions
outgoing_fields.historical_package: only allowlisted full frozen result envelopes in prepared/package.json
outgoing_fields.dynamic_followups: prior approved input + validated original Provider output in original order + actual committed call_id/name/arguments/result-bound outputs
outgoing_fields.checks_each_round: fixed scope, runtime_budget, budget_instructions, strict schemas, first-body hash, sensitive field/value checks, canonical 131072 byte limit
outgoing_fields.zero_budget_or_last_round: tools=[] and tool_choice=none; any returned function_call rejected before Worker tool execution

historical_argument_matching: exact arguments/source matching; omitted log bounds alias to frozen logs only; unmatched queries no_data/rejection, never current I/O
stop_conditions: missing new human authorization or mismatched source/SDK/manifest/request/plan: stop before SDK
existing plan consumption reservation: stop, never delete or release reservation
any transport, timeout, protocol, incomplete response, sensitive content, size or binding error: stop without retry
tool quota reached: transaction refuses execution, pending calls have no invented outputs
function_call when tools disabled or on model round 3: reject and stop
one Worker run, one Incident/attempt only; no retry/resume/fallback/rerun/P6.6
model concludes without tools or next turn: retain the result, do not rerun to obtain acceptance
success_criteria: Worker executes and commits permitted tool results
real second SDK request contains committed original call/output pairs
real DeepSeek continues or concludes after receiving those results
cost_provider_timeout_risks: prices, balance, actual fees and billing status unknown; no online lookup performed
at most three potentially paid SDK entries with growing resent input; bytes are not tokens or money
SDK timeout and cooperative runtime checks are not a hard experiment wall-clock deadline
timeout/error may still be billed; local SDK entry is not server receipt/billing proof
real Provider acceptance of v3 and real round 2 behavior remain unverified
five tools accommodates the sealed sample, not every future autonomous response
execution_requirement: after independent review/new human approval, reverify exact source tree and SDK manifest plus prepared/request hashes; import only this frozen tree, never newer dirty main
